title: Run plan

changelog.reason: added schema_version and run as required top-level fields; schema had drifted behind plan.template.json
unit.checks and interfaces[].check now reference tests-map check ids (T<n>) instead of names; tests map became a first-class versioned document

description: A plan decomposes a frozen spec into dispatchable units of work. It is produced by the orchestrator in plan mode, validated against this schema, approved by a human at the plan gate, and consumed three times: by the orchestrator to dispatch workers, by the report assembler to reconcile plan against outcome, and by the human reviewing it. The plan contains references into the spec, never copies of spec text. Invariants that this schema cannot express, to be checked by the plan validator before the gate: (1) every behaviour and edge id in the spec appears in exactly one unit's spec_refs; (2) every id in a unit's needs appears in some interface's id; (3) every interface is produced by exactly one unit or stubbed in the interfaces phase; (4) no path appears in more than one unit's owns; (5) every id in a unit's checks exists as a live check in the tests map; (6) every group referenced in order exists on at least one unit, and every unit's group appears in order exactly once; (7) a unit whose needs include an interface produced by another unit must be in a later wave than that unit; (8) units with a non-empty decisions array carry the human-decision flag.

plan_version.description: Revision of this plan for this run. Bumped on every edit or re-plan; the approval block pins one revision.

path.description: Repository path of the frozen spec this plan decomposes.

commit.description: Commit at which the spec was frozen.

spec_version.description: The spec's own version number at freeze. Drift between this and the test map's spec version is a gate flag.

kickoff.description: The kickoff this run is conducted under. Informational for the report; the plan does not restate any of it.

status.description: Only an approved plan may be dispatched. Approval is recorded in the approval block.

spec_version.description: Spec version visible at approval; must equal spec.spec_version.

plan_hash.description: Hash of this file at approval, minus this block. Dispatch and assembly verify it so the plan executed is the plan approved.

approval.description: Written by the gate page on approve. Absent while status is draft.

interfaces.description: The seams: everything one unit exposes and another consumes. Built or confirmed in the interfaces phase before parallel work, then locked. First-class here so the interfaces phase has a single input list and each seam a contract check.

id.description: Stable id, never reused or renumbered.

name.description: The type, function, route, schema or format name as it appears in code.

reuse.description: "new", or "existing:<name>" when the spec requires reusing something already in the codebase. Existing seams are confirmed, not created.

path.description: File that carries the seam. Joins the protected set at interface-gate approval.

check.description: Tests-map check id (T<n>) of the contract check that verifies this seam's shape.

spec_ref.description: Optional pointer to the spec interface entry this realises.

stub.description: True when the seam is declared with a not-implemented body in the interfaces phase and implemented by its producing unit later; false when the declaration is complete in itself (types, routes, schemas, migrations).

id.description: Stable id, never reused or renumbered. The join key for prompts, returns, events, checks and the report ledger.

name.description: Short human name, a few words.

spec_refs.description: Behaviour and edge ids this unit is accountable for. References only; the renderer resolves full text from the spec at dispatch.

owns.description: Paths this unit may write. Its diff boundary. No path may appear in another unit's owns.

needs.description: Interfaces consumed, read-only to this unit.

produces.description: Interfaces whose stubbed bodies this unit implements. The seam's declaration is already locked; only the body is this unit's to write.

checks.description: Tests-map check ids (T<n>) that must be green for this unit to land. Always includes the contract checks of every interface in needs and produces; for units in later waves, also the behaviour checks of the earlier units they build on.

worker.description: Agent role from .claude/agents/ that runs this unit.

model.description: Model tier for this unit's worker.

group.description: Parallel group. Units sharing a group run concurrently; order sequences the groups.

size.description: Effort estimate; feeds budget ceilings and gate attention.

flags.description: Closed set defined by the template; recommended values: modify-existing (touches a file that exists in production), risk (touches auth, data migration, or anything the spec's constraints name), human-decision (decisions is non-empty).

decisions.description: Every call this plan made where the spec was silent, one sentence each. Read first at the plan gate.

iterations.description: Maximum attempts against this unit's checks before the worker must return failed. Defaults from the kickoff when absent.

items.description: One wave: group ids dispatched concurrently.

order.description: The dispatch schedule as waves of groups. A wave starts only when the previous wave's units have landed. Within a wave, units depend on interfaces only, never on each other's implementations.

run.description: Run id, matches the runs/ folder.
